name: merge-rollback-reset-failure-leaves-landed
body: The rollback path is exercised only by the two phase-4 e2e tests (`merge_failed_rebuild_leaves_the_merge_unlanded_and_the_project_retryable` and `merge_failed_rebuild_before_writing_keeps_the_pre_merge_graph`). If the hard reset to the pre-merge commit itself fails, main stays landed with a stale graph: the code bails with an explicit `run apg scan` fix and is not data-destructive. Upgrade if a reset failure must also be recovered automatically.
